_note: The gym (src/components/arcade/games/gym): six stations, each a short skill game that builds one body stat. stars = the score needed for 1, 2 and 3 stars. gain = body-stat points per star (stats run 0 to 100 and fade by fadePerDay for each day after idleDays without training). Body stats feed boxing: stamina raises your stamina pool and recovery, strength your punch power (see games/boxing).

stations.name: Treadmill · Sandstorm Sprint
stations.how: Tap in rhythm to hold the pace. When the sandstorm rolls up Sheikh Zayed Road on the screen, sprint to stay ahead of it.

stations.name: Squat rack · Power Lift
stations.how: Tap as the bar marker crosses the green zone to drive each rep up, and drag to keep the bar level. The zone shrinks as you tire.

stations.name: Heavy bag · Combo Rush
stations.how: Hit the punch shown on the beat: jab, cross, left hook, right hook. Perfect timing chains the combo and swings the bag.

stations.name: Rower · Creek Regatta
stations.how: Hold to drive, let go to recover. Long smooth strokes in rhythm move the boat fastest. Beat your ghost to the finish.

stations.name: Spin class · Beat Ride
stations.how: Tap the beats as they reach the line, in three lanes. Hold through the long climbs. Keep the combo going.

stations.name: Yoga · Balance Flow
stations.how: Drag to keep the dot inside the circle as you hold each pose. The wobble grows with every pose.
